reuse.why: Builds on the existing EDITABLE_CATEGORY_FILTER and getBudgetData, and adds one fixed-group lookup used by both the category-list actions and copyPreviousMonth.

duplication.why: Removes five pasted category queries in favour of getEditableCategories and keeps the #fixed rule in getFixedGroupIds; only the pre-existing split between the SQL filter and copyPreviousMonth's JS checks remains.

placement.why: Selection helpers sit next to EDITABLE_CATEGORY_FILTER/hasSavedTemplates in budget/actions.ts, where the tree keeps month-wide action logic.

scope.why: Focused on the fixed-group exclusion plus a consolidation of the identical queries it had to touch.

maintainability.why: The fixed-group rule is a named, single definition; the eligibility rule still lives in two forms (SQL filter + JS checks in copyPreviousMonth), plus an extra query for fixed groups.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions route through EDITABLE_CATEGORY_FILTER/getEditableCategories or getFixedGroupIds; copyPreviousMonth uses hasSavedTemplates as before.

disguised_duplication.where: The #fixed check is one function consumed by both paths; no reshaped copy is introduced.

one_place.where: getFixedGroupIds() in budget/actions.ts (with FIXED_TAG), used by getEditableCategories (setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending) and copyPreviousMonth.
